boundary: rigid walls; no boundary-face flux degrees of freedom
initial_condition: p(0)=K(x)*f_source(x), p_dot(0)=0; source f has zero discrete mean
source_port: each Gaussian normalized to unit discrete integral, then mean removed
receiver_port: unit-integral Gaussian pressure average; mean not removed
coefficients: same analytic rho and bulk modulus K sampled at each grid cell centre
face_density: arithmetic average of adjacent cell-centred rho
propagator: Energy-skew sparse exponential through grid 256 and for rotated_stripes at 384; full-order Chebyshev-Bessel matrix cosine for other 384 cases and all 512 cases.
interpretation: differences between discrete solutions; not rigorous continuum-error bounds
data_scope: Three specified development media, with the same fixed sources and receivers at every grid.
output_norm: Frobenius norm over t>0, four receivers, three sources; fine-grid denominator.
